About

I started Tidewater Labs in 2023 to build sensors that measure ocean carbon removal. Before that I spent six years designing batteries at a large automaker.

My latest essay, "Hardware founders should raise less, earlier", argues that climate hardware companies should raise smaller pre-seed rounds to prove a working prototype first.
